cases.question: 查询我在《数据库原理及安全》这门课的成绩，包括课程名称和分数，按课程名称排序。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.course_name, g.score FROM academic.grades AS g JOIN academic.course_offerings AS o ON o.offering_id = g.offering_id JOIN academic.courses AS c ON c.course_id = o.course_id WHERE g.student_id = 'S01' AND c.course_id = 'C01' ORDER BY c.course_name
cases.review_note: 必须限定 S01 和课程 C01，并通过 offering_id 关联课程名称与成绩。

cases.question: 查询我在 2026-fall 学期选修的教学班编号。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT e.offering_id FROM academic.enrollments AS e JOIN academic.course_offerings AS o ON o.offering_id = e.offering_id WHERE e.student_id = 'S01' AND o.term = '2026-fall' ORDER BY e.offering_id
cases.review_note: 学期字段是 course_offerings.term，不在 enrollments 表。

cases.question: 列出我选过的课程名称、学分和授课教师姓名。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.course_name, c.credits, t.display_name FROM academic.enrollments AS e JOIN academic.course_offerings AS o ON o.offering_id = e.offering_id JOIN academic.courses AS c ON c.course_id = o.course_id JOIN academic.teachers AS t ON t.teacher_id = o.teacher_id WHERE e.student_id = 'S01' ORDER BY c.course_name
cases.review_note: 同一课程可能有多个教学班；需要 DISTINCT 并限定本人。

cases.question: 查询我所授教学班的成绩记录数。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) AS grade_count FROM academic.grades AS g JOIN academic.course_offerings AS o ON o.offering_id = g.offering_id WHERE o.teacher_id = 'T01'
cases.review_note: 必须限定 T01 所授教学班；预期 20 条（O01 与 O03 各 10 条）。

cases.question: 查看我可以展示的脱敏联系方式。
cases.review_note: 只能查询本人脱敏视图，不得读取底层联系方式列。

cases.question: 查询我低于 60 分的课程名称和分数。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.course_name, g.score FROM academic.grades AS g JOIN academic.course_offerings AS o ON o.offering_id = g.offering_id JOIN academic.courses AS c ON c.course_id = o.course_id WHERE g.student_id = 'S01' AND g.score < 60 ORDER BY c.course_name
cases.review_note: 必须限定 S01，并使用 score < 60。

cases.question: 列出 O01 教学班最近的公开课程反馈内容，最多 3 条。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT content FROM academic.course_feedback WHERE offering_id = 'O01' AND visibility = 'public' ORDER BY created_at DESC, feedback_id LIMIT 3
cases.review_note: 仅公开反馈；不暴露作者 ID，也不读取非公开记录。
